title: The Seven Spells Of Destruction
summary: Remember those adventure gamebooks where every decision could lead to treasure, or a particularly unpleasant death? Welcome to Cryptillia. A vast multiplayer fantasy world where thousands of locations await you, and your next decision might just be your last. Bring your imagination. You'll need it.
about:
DO YOU REMEMBER WHEN RPGs WERE STORIES YOU READ?

When an adventure was something you imagined, rather than something rendered on a screen?

When finding a mysterious door was exciting because you genuinely had no idea what might be behind it?

When getting lost was part of the adventure, dying actually meant something, and the world didn't politely rearrange itself to make sure you won?

Seven Spells remembers.

WELCOME TO CRYPTILLIA

The Seven Spells of Destruction is a free-to-play, text-based online fantasy role-playing game inspired by the classic gamebooks and computer RPGs of decades past.

Explore an enormous world of ancient castles, forgotten dungeons, dangerous wilderness, bustling settlements and secrets buried beneath centuries of history.

Your adventure unfolds through richly written storytelling, atmospheric illustrations and an original fantasy soundtrack.

But don't mistake the absence of flashy 3D graphics for a lack of depth.

This is a world with teeth.

YOUR ADVENTURE. YOUR DECISIONS. YOUR CONSEQUENCES.

Create your character, choose your race and profession, and set out into a world that doesn't revolve around you.

Fight monsters. Discover forgotten scrolls. Solve riddles. Hunt for food. Trade with merchants. Explore places you probably shouldn't.

Sometimes you'll triumph.

Sometimes you'll make a terrible mistake.

And sometimes you'll discover that the most dangerous thing in Cryptillia isn't a monster. It's your own curiosity.

There isn't always a convenient way to undo what you've done.

AN OLD-SCHOOL RPG IN A MODERN ONLINE WORLD

Seven Spells combines the spirit of traditional text adventures with the possibilities of a persistent online game.

• 
A vast world to explore. Hundreds upon hundreds of locations, with hidden paths, strange encounters and secrets waiting to be discovered.
• 
Persistent characters. Build your adventurer over time, developing their abilities, wealth, equipment and reputation.
• 
Meaningful character progression. Different races, professions, equipment and skills shape your journey.
• 
Dangerous combat. Monsters, demons and other creatures aren't there merely to decorate the scenery.
• 
Riddles and mysteries. Pay attention to what you read. The answers aren't always handed to you.
• 
A shared online world. Adventure alongside a community of other players in a world that continues to grow.
• 
Achievements and discoveries. From heroic victories to spectacularly embarrassing failures, your adventures leave their mark.
• 
Illustrated storytelling and atmospheric music. Modern presentation brings the old-fashioned adventure to life without replacing your imagination.

NO BATTLE PASS. NO PRESSURE TO KEEP UP.

There's no need to race through the adventure, complete a daily checklist or keep up with somebody else's progress.

Take your time.

Read the stories.

Explore that suspicious-looking passage.

Spend an evening trying to work out a riddle.

Or wander off into the wilderness and discover something nobody told you was there.

The adventure is there when you want it.

THE SEVEN SPELLS ARE WAITING

Somewhere in Cryptillia, ancient powers are stirring.

The demon lord Garneth casts a long shadow over the land, and the Seven Spells of Destruction are more than a legend.

What they are, where they lie, and what will happen when their secrets are uncovered is for you to discover.

Nobody promises you'll survive.

Nobody promises you'll succeed.

And nobody promises that every story has a happy ending.

But whatever happens...

SEVEN SPELLS REMEMBERS.

A text-based online RPG like your uncle played.

FREE TO PLAY.
